user.title: TV Message
user.description: Enter the TV's IP address. The TV may be off while you set it up.

show.name: Show message
show.description: Show a message on the TV screen. Retries while a just-powered-on TV wakes up.

duration.name: Duration (s)
duration.description: Remove the message after this many seconds.

host.name: TV address
host.description: Leave empty to target every configured TV.

wait_for_tv.name: Wait for TV (s)
wait_for_tv.description: Maximum time to keep retrying until the TV answers

clear.name: Clear message
clear.description: Stop the message that is currently shown.
